verdict.rationale: Airweave syncs and stores copies of third-party data, so controlling retention and deletion is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no retention policies, deletion endpoints, or data-purge controls. Self-hosting (docs-14) is a deployment option, not a retention or deletion control. The vague "manage your collections" Pipedream action does not show deletion or retention capability, and community comments only raise the question.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
